relevance_note: Case report of two siblings with Danon disease carrying a LAMP2 variant: 'The two probands shared the same mutation, c.974delTinsAA in exon 8'.
method_note: Transcribed by hand into a short Python builder script (no tables in the paper); every span checked verbatim by script. Scope: the two LAMP2 carriers (Patients II.1, II.3), the four other pedigree members the text describes (I.1 and III.1 tested negative; I.2 the mother of II.1 with sudden cardiac death, not tested; II.2 described as normal, testing not stated), and literature persons from the Discussion with an individual-level fact beyond diagnosis: refs (11), (12) (38-year-old carrier mother and her son), (16), (19), (20), (24). Group-level literature statements (refs 3, 4, 6, 7, 17, 18, 21, 23) gave no rows. 'These results were consistent with those of a further case (20)' was treated as the same ref (20) person described later (no separate facts). Contradictions/oddities in the paper: (1) the variant is printed as c.974delTinsAA in the abstract, case report and Fig. 2 legend but as 'c.974delT' in the Discussion; c.974delTinsAA recorded. (2) Patient II.1 is called 'heterozygous' and the male Patient II.3 'homozygous'; recorded as stated, not converted to hemizygous. (3) Both probands have a pathological diagnosis of 'myogenic fiber disorder myopathy' on muscle biopsy, yet the Discussion says 'the two probands ... did not exhibit any clinical indication of skeletal myopathy'; both feature rows emitted and the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' set to not reported for both. (4) The mother's label is printed 'Patient I:2' once and 'Patient I.2' once; 'Patient I.2' used to match the II.1/II.3 form. (5) The text says 'The ECG examination revealed interventricular septum hypertrophy' for II.3 (presumably echocardiography); recorded as LVH without changing the wording. Age choices: II.1 age at diagnosis is the age of DCM diagnosis (26 y); last evaluation = death at 28 y. II.3 age at last evaluation = '23-year-old' (age at presentation; follow-up continued about 2 more years with no age given). 'procarbamide transaminase' kept as printed (not mapped to a named transaminase); AST supports the liver-enzyme checklist item. Normal findings recorded per D-27: 'normal psychomotor development' (I.1, III.1) as excluded abnormal psychomotor development and excluded developmental delay on the checklist; whole-examination statements (II.2 'no sign of mental or physical disorders'; ref (12) 'no specific abnormalities in the ECG, physical examination and blood biochemistry'; ref (16) 'normal presentation on cardiac evaluation') recorded as written and exclude no specific checklist item. Intellectual disability and clinical skeletal myopathy marked excluded for both probands from the sentence naming 'the two probands'. Parental testing not recorded: I.1 tested negative but the paper does not state that I.1 is a parent. ref (12) persons: variant rows kept with variant and gene 'not reported' (the text says only 'the same mutation'). ref (24): variant described only as 'a LAMP2 microduplication'; variant string not reported, type recorded as large deletion/CNV. Reference-list titles were not used as evidence about any person.
